findings.condition: The revoke button (`この端末の予約閲覧権を失効`) is rendered unconditionally and enabled (`disabled={busy}` only) even while `view` is still null — e.g. during the initial page-load window before the mount `useEffect`'s `request('')` resolves, or immediately after the user clicks `予約を再読込` (reload(), which itself calls `setView(null)` before awaiting the GET). If the guest clicks revoke during that null-view window, `if(view)sessionStorage.setItem(pendingKey,view.id)` is skipped, so `bookingId=sessionStorage.getItem(pendingKey)` resolves to null (no prior pendingKey exists yet on a fresh visit). The POST /revoke still succeeds and genuinely revokes the live capability server-side (booking_access.capabilities row + cookie cleared).
findings.impact: Because `bookingId` was null, the cleanup line `if(bookingId)sessionStorage.removeItem('zao-booking-access-request:'+bookingId)` never runs, so the cached (now-stale) requestId for that booking is left in sessionStorage even though the server-side capability really was revoked and acknowledged (status 200, no network loss). The very next explicit Save gesture for the same booking in the same tab reuses that stale requestId (SaveBookingAccess.save() only mints a fresh UUID `if(!requestId)`), which maps to the now-revoked (booking_id, request_id) primary key in booking_access.capabilities, and booking_access.issue()'s `IF FOUND ... old.revoked_at IS NOT NULL ... RAISE EXCEPTION BOOKING_ACCESS_DENIED` fires. This reproduces the exact permanent per-tab lockout that BA-01 was meant to close, through an adjacent, untested trigger (revoke clicked while `view` is transiently null) rather than the originally-described trigger (revoke response merely delayed/lost).
findings.evidence: apps/web/src/components/BookingAccess.tsx lines 8/17-19 (view starts as `useState<View|null>(null)`; `reload()` calls `setView(null)` before awaiting; the revoke button has no `!view` or loading guard) and lines 22-28 (the `if(view)` guard used to seed `pendingKey`). The added test in tests/readiness/booking-access-ui.ts ('acknowledged revoke then deliberate resave' stage) only exercises revoke after `await expect(page.getByRole('img',{name:'保存済み予約QR'})).toBeVisible()` — i.e., always with `view` populated — so this null-view path is never reached by the new coverage, and neither the before/after logs nor the CI run (34766382766) exercise it.
findings.fix: Track the currently-bound booking id independently of the transient `view` state, e.g. a ref updated whenever `view` becomes non-null (`useEffect(()=>{if(view)lastBookingId.current=view.id;},[view])`), and seed `pendingKey`/`bookingId` from that ref (falling back to the existing sessionStorage pendingKey) rather than solely from `view` at click time. Alternatively/additionally, disable the revoke button until the initial read (or an in-flight reload()) has settled, closing the window entirely.
findings.test: Extend tests/readiness/booking-access-ui.ts: after issuing a capability and confirming the saved view, click `予約を再読込` and, without waiting for that GET to resolve (e.g. delay it via page.route), immediately click `この端末の予約閲覧権を失効`; assert the revoke completes (200) and that `sessionStorage.getItem('zao-booking-access-request:'+bookingId)` is cleared, then assert a subsequent Save for the same booking returns 200 with a new requestId rather than reproducing BOOKING_ACCESS_DENIED.
